title: Episode 085 — Pubes Everywhere
summary: Episode 85 is a compact year-end record of the show's growing fan ecosystem, action-first hiring philosophy, ensemble photo production, platform strategy, informal labor and creative-risk doctrine. Yen, Scrotum Coat, Dark Dick, Mo's Minis, Yacuzzi Boy and Deathbuster appear as examples of fans creating before asking for access. The most useful thesis is that visibility invites criticism and that making work requires leaving the sidelines. The episode itself supplies the necessary correction: that thesis cannot be used to erase informed consent or reduce a model's job to hunger, body perfection and surprise nudity. A participant says he did not know the photo would be nude; the room pressures workers to undress, make genital contact and treat discomfort as failed professionalism. USDA guidance also corrects the claim that hot-food donation is impossible because recipients sue: federal protections cover qualifying good-faith donations, though the route and local food-safety rules matter. ACOG confirms there is no medical or hygienic need to remove pubic hair. Racial beauty rankings, inbreeding theories and retaliatory health allegations are rejected. Eleven opening vocals remain an audio-review hold. Named dialogue remains withheld.
speaker_policy: UNKNOWN by default. Five coarse legacy windows and zero deliberately unrequested turns cannot support names. Cast metadata describes participation but never assigns transcript lines.
sensitivity: Five exact public-layer redactions protect fans, workers, partners and former employees.
The nude photo-shoot sequence remains restricted accountability evidence.
The 11 removed opening vocals require listening before restore/drop acceptance.
Health, food-donation, workplace and genetic claims are contextualized, never silently rewritten.
source_notes: Twenty-seven cleaner drops are empty zero-duration artifacts.
Eleven `Now let's go` spans at 8.66–29.98 total 21.32 seconds and may be intentional opening vocals; the correction layer queues audio review rather than accepting their deletion.

USDA explains federal liability protection for qualifying good-faith food donation and the distinct rules for nonprofit versus qualified direct-donor routes: https://www.usda.gov/sites/default/files/documents/FAQs-GoodSamaritanAct.pdf
ACOG says pubic hair has no required hygienic removal and shaving/waxing can cause injury or infection: https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/vulvovaginal-health
Scrotum Coat, Dark Dick, Mo's Minis, Deathbuster and Yacuzzi Boy are fan/source leads, not independently verified biography.
